name: Eyes: full glow (power peak)
description: Eyes: fully glowing {{MAGIC}}, irises and pupils blazing with luminous {{MAGIC}} light and no visible pupil, a faint {{MAGIC}} glow reaching the lashes and upper cheeks (override the incoming eye colour).
